text: Punisher Simius (Japanese: , Panisshu Shimiusu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Simius and can be found at level 51 in the Canopied Nightwood in Noctilum.

Prowler Ovis (Japanese: , Purourā Owisu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Ovis family, and can be found at level 12-18 at the Ruins on the Butte in Oblivia. Six of them must be defeated during Offing Ovis (Prowler).
The Qmoeva Divider (Japanese: , Kumūba Dibaido) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Qmoeva machine and is fought at level 14 on Oblivia's Aaroy Plain during Foggy Dilemma.
Putrid Falsaxums (Japanese: , Rotten Garukasu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Falsaxum family, and can be found at level 40 in North Coast in Oblivia.

Pursuit Qmoevas (Japanese: , Cheisu Kumūba) are two Story and Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Qmoeva machines, Ganglion's Skells type, and can be found at level 29 at the NLA Primary Defense Line in Primordia during Chapter 8, when the Ganglion attack the East Gate of New Los Angeles. They must be defeated in the second wave of Ganglion attacks.
Qmoevas (Japanese: , Kumūba) are a type of the Ganglion's Skells in Xenoblade Chronicles X. In contrast to the Skells used by BLADE, Qmoevas resemble large suits of plate armor.
Quiet Murras (Japanese: , Kuwaieto Tondomu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Murra family, and can be found at level 35 in Sylvalum.
Purger Queen Qmoevas (Japanese: , Pājikuīn Kumūba) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Ganglion Qmoevas and can be found at level 41-50 near O'rrh Sim Castle Ruins in Cauldros.

The Proto Assault Rifle is a ranged weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is an Assault Rifle. It is Cross's initial Ranged weapon, received from Elma at the beginning of the game, and cannot be obtained by any other means.

The Prone Scouts (Japanese: , Baiasu Sukauto) are two story exclusive enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and are fought at level 7 during Chapter 3 at the entrance to Seaswept Base in Primordia.
Quincy (Japanese: , Kuinshī) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is located at Division Drive in the Administrative District during the day. He is a team leader within the Curators Division.
Prone Eagles (Japanese: , Baiasu Īguru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 41-50 at Lakeview Stronghold or Waterway Tangle in Noctilum.
Prone Judges (Japanese: , Baiasu Jajji) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 41-50 at Lakeview Stronghold or Waterway Tangle in Noctilum.

Prospective Partners (Japanese: , Jussaku, Intrigue) is an Affinity Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be received in the BLADE Barracks, near the Story Mission icon. In the Definitive Edition, this mission is required in order to unlock Chapter 10.
Pulala (English dub: ) is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She can be found at Ishmael Hills in the Residential District of New Los Angeles during the night.
Prone Furies (Japanese: , Baiasu Beruseruku) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 41-50 at Alexander Ridge in Oblivia.
Prone Vix Owls (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Ouru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 21-30 at Barbarich Desert in Oblivia.
The Prototype Headset is BLADE Wear head armor in and . It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.
The Proto Knife is a melee weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Knife. It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.
The Prototype Shirt is BLADE Wear torso armor in and . It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.

Queen's Raptures (Japanese: , Joō no Kōkotsu) are common collectibles in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be found in Sylvalum, in particular on the Waters or more commonly around the Delusians North Summit. Five of them are needed during Glamor Girl.
Rabbit Research is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from a biologist and the primary destination is Primordia. fr:Recherches sur les lapins
Prone Eaters (Japanese: , Baiasu Ītā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone troopers, and can be found at level 42-47 at the Seaswept Base in Primordia.
Quince (Japanese: , Kuinsu) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. She is located on North Founders Street in the Commercial District.

Pyotr, the Shepherd (Japanese: , Hitsujikai no Pyōtoru) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Sylooth family. It can be found at level 74 in Noctilum at Narcissus Tree, accompanied by Heidi, the Lively and Claire, the Sheltered. Pyotr, the Shepherd gains Enraged VI buff when one of its ovis are killed. When both are killed, it gains significant resistance to damage.

The Pursuit Satellis Alpha (Japanese: , Cheisu Sateresu α) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 47 in the Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. It assists the Vita during the second battle round. The Pursuit Satellis Alpha does not attack directly, instead orbiting a chosen target and damaging them with its proximity spike that deals ether damage and inflicts Ether Res Down. This boss and the other Satellises are not registered in the Enemy Index, only the Vita and the Sentinel Satellis will be registered.

The Pursuit Satellis Beta (Japanese: , Cheisu Sateresu β) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 47 at Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. It assists the Vita during the second round. It appears when the Shield Satellis is down and the Vita is still fighting for a period of time. Once summoned it chooses a target and explodes, damaging the target. Upon attacking, it inflicts Ether Res Down as well as spike damage. This boss and the other Satellises are not registered in the Enemy Index, only the Vita and the Sentinel Satellis will be registered.

The Pursuit Satellis Gamma (Japanese: , Cheisu Sateresu γ) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is fought at level 47 at Lifehold Core's Interior during Chapter 12. It assists the Vita during the second round. This boss and the other Satellises are not registered in the Enemy Index, only the Vita and the Sentinel Satellis will be registered.

The Prototype Puge (Japanese: , Shisaku-gata Berude) is a Tyrant in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a Puge machine, a Ganglion's human size robot. It can be found at level 49 at Bedrock Hold in Primordia, in the southeast building's second floor accompanied by two Marnuck Jaegers.

Puddle Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Padoru Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family, and can be found at level 39 at the watering hole at Scholes Battlegrounds and at level 38 in M'gando Gorge in Cauldros.
Pyro Sacrifoles (Japanese: , Pairo Kurusuta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Sacrifole family and can be found at level 33-35 at the Secluded Lava Lake in Sylvalum.

Quick Aetrygons (Japanese: , Kuikku Derupinu) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Aetrygon family and can be found at level 11-20 in Oblivia, in particular along the river in the center of Oblivia, one hex south of FN Site 309. They can drop the Beryl Aetrygon Horn needed for From Idea to Inventory.

Raging Cantors (Japanese: , Reiji Imupureka) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are members of the Cantor family, and are fought at level 22 (first battle) and 23 (second battle) at the Biahno Water-Purification Plant in Primordia during the Normal Mission Lakeside Getaway.
Prone Owls (Japanese: , Baiasu Ouru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 21-30 in Noctilum's Ensconced Citadel.
Prone Rampagers (Japanese: , Baiasu Ranpēji) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 21-30 in Noctilum, northeast of FN Site 211.

Prone Savages (Japanese: , Baiasu Sabēji) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and a kindred trio of them can be found at level 42-45 in Oblivia, west of the Scabland Fortress northern entrance.
Prone Slayers (Japanese: , Baiasu Mōtaru) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 21-30 in Noctilum's Ensconced Citadel.
Prone Soldiers (Japanese: , Baiasu Sorujā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 at Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Sorcerers (Japanese: , Baiasu Sōsarā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 at Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Trainers (Japanese: , Baiasu Torēnā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 41-50 in Primordia, near FN Site 119.

Prone Vix Alphas (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Arufa) are minor enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are female Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 on the rim of the Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Vix Betas (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Bēta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 on the rim of the Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Vix Deltas (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Deruta) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 59 at Cavernous Abyss in Sylvalum.
Prone Vix Brutalizers (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Baiorento) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 41-50 in Oblivia's Scabland Fortress.
Prone Vix Crows (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Kurou) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 21-30 near the entrance to Rooney Cavern in Oblivia.

Prone Vix Griffins (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Gurifon) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 46-47 in Primordia. One guards Greater Gemini Bridge at level 46, while others can be found at level 47 in southwestern Seaswept Base.
Prone Vix Guards (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Gādo) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 11-20 in Oblivia's Mesa Fortress.

Prone Vix Prisoners (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Purizunā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 30 in Noctilum, in the Ensconced Citadel accompanying Demetrio, the Tempestuous.
Prone Vix Vultures (Japanese: , Baiasu Muru Varuchā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 31-40 in Oblivia, north of FN Site 309.

Prone Vultures (Japanese: , Baiasu Varuchā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion and can be found at level 31-40 in Oblivia, north of FN Site 309 in the Milligan Supply Base reachable by following the road atop the Big Arch.

The Queen Chimera (Japanese: , Kuīn Kimaera) is a Main Boss in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Chimera family, and is summoned at level 50 inside the Lifehold Core by Lao during Chapter 12. The Queen Chimera can be assisted by the level 48-49 Major, Mezzo or Minor Chimeras if the fight lasts long. None of these Chimeras are registered in the Enemy Index, except Lao as well as the Soldier Chimeras from the previous battle.
Puge Counters are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the heads of Puges.

Quick Shrads (Japanese: , Kuikku Zuttā) are enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Shrad machines and can be found at level 37-39 in Cauldros. They patrol the pathways between the Forgotten Mining Frigates, together with Rocket Jacul. They can be found on the pathways above FN Site 504, for example. They can also be found at the Boxtrap Checkpoint and Kw'arah Cloister.
Pugilith Lamps are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Pugiliths in Primordia or Noctilum.
Quick Reload is a Skill in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked as a Astral Crusader at rank 5. Cross, Alexa, Lao and Bozé can use this skill.
Purgovent Jaw Meats are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Purgovents.
Prone Sweet Prone (Japanese: , Dorairando Kyūshutsu Sakusen, Operation Dryland Rescue) is a Normal Mission in . It can be received from Stella at the Administrative District in New Los Angeles.

The Purge Purgovent (Japanese: , Pāji Morumu) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Purgovent family, and can be found at level 29 at the Vitriol Cesspool in Noctilum during The Voltant Visionary.
Quiquat (Japanese: , Kikwatto) is an NPC in and . She is a Ma-non and can be found near North Founders Street in Commercial District of New Los Angeles.
Qmoevan Capacitors are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Qmoevas in Oblivia. Three are needed for the Affinity Mission Two Peas in a Pod.

The Prone Keeper (Japanese: , Baiasu Kīpā) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 12 at Sea Whisper Valley in Oblivia. Defeating him is required during The Trading Floor B Route.

Prone Fighters (Japanese: , Baiasu Faitā) are two Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 12 at Sea Whisper Valley in Oblivia. Defeating them is required during The Trading Floor B Route.

Quegga Zeblaga (Japanese: , Kuega Zebugara) is an NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He is a Tree Clan Prone whose corpse can be found in Oblivia's Barbarich Desert during the Normal Mission A Grim Undertaking. Since this is the only way of meeting him, he is one of few NPCs to not have an actual picture on the Affinity Chart as well as no affinity links going from him.

The Queen Jacul (Japanese: , Kuīn Hasutara) is a Mission Exclusive Enemy in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a member of the Jacul family, fought at level 45 at Mount M'gando in Cauldros during The Queen Is Dead.

Prone Hunting Prowess is Info in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be acquired from Onze Vilgabo in exchange for a Silver Evello Card during Trade Agreement, and can then be traded to Wilbur for a Silver Xiphias Card.
Quegga's Note is an Important Item in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is found on or near Quegga Zeblaga's body in Oblivia's Barbarich Desert during the Normal Mission A Grim Undertaking.

Quegga's Gift (Japanese: , Kuega no Okurimono) is a Normal Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is received automatically from Hala Gorida during A Grim Undertaking after searching Quegga Zeblaga's body in Oblivia's Barbarich Desert.
Rada Valdileo is a NPC in Xenoblade Chronicles X. He can be found at the Starboard side of the Ma-non Ship in New Los Angeles during the day. He is the brother of Oll Valdileo.
Pugilith Pounder is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Reclaimers and the primary destination is Cauldros.
Purgovent Purge is a Basic Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is a request from the Dorian Caravan and the primary destination is Oblivia.

Prone Hearthkeepers (Japanese: , Baiasu Vesuta) are Mission Exclusive Enemies in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Prone Ganglion, and can be found at level 34 at Sapphire Table in Noctilum. They must be defeated during The King of Fear. They drop no treasure.

Puge Self-Destruct Mechanisms are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Puges. They are components in Resist Taunt and Resist.TAUNT augments. One is needed for The Unbreakable Sword.

Purple Scintimure Tentacles are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purple Scintimures, or for 114 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Electric Res Up and SpecUp.ELEC-RES augments

Purple Virago Alloy Plates are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from purple Viragos, or for 138 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are components in X, XV, and XX Back Attack Plus and PositionDmg.BACK augments.
Quo Pods are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Quos.

R.B. Units are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Lyla's Galdr, or for 90 Reward Tickets at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks. They are used in X, XV, and XX Ranged Accuracy Drive augments.
Pure White Caro Tusks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Caro. They are used to craft Boost.M-ATK Skell Frame augments.

Quality Vigent Claws are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from Vigents. They are components in X, XV, and XX Aura Rapid Cooldown augments. One is needed for the related mission Partners in Prototyping.

Purple Cervus Antlers are unique materials in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They can be obtained from the horn appendage of purple Cervuses. They are components in X, XV, and XX Ether Attack Plus and AttributeDmg.ETHER augments.
Purgovent A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white purgovent variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Albin, the Wicked Meddler in Sylvalum.
Purgovent B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a dark gray purgovent variant. It can be obtained from silver drops from Libra, the Long-Lived.

Prone Male is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a male Prone variant. It can be obtained from Langul, the Alien Payload in Primordia, or Dadaan, the Strongest Prone in Oblivia after Chapter 12.
Prone Female is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a female Prone variant. It can be obtained from Vendura, the Spellbinder in Oblivia.
Puge A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white puge variant. It can be obtained from Prototype Puge in Primordia.
Puge B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black puge variant. It can be obtained from Night Combat Puge in Cauldros.
Pugilith A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from the Raider Pugilith in Oblivia.
Pugilith B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It can be obtained from High-Output Pugilith in Sylvalum.
Quo A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a black quo variant. It can be obtained from the Logistical Support Quo in Primordia.
Quo B is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a white quo variant. It can be obtained from the Frontline Medic Quo in Cauldros.
Qmoeva A is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a standard silvery qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from the Infantry Support Qmoeva in Noctilum.
Qmoeva B is a Holofigure in . It depicts a standard silvery Qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from the Experimental Composite Qmoeva in Primordia.
Qmoeva C is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a standard silvery qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from the Intermediate Arsenal Qmoeva in Primordia.
Qmoeva D is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a standard silvery qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from the Support Trainee Qmoeva in Primordia.
Qmoeva E is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a red qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from Daril's Qmoeva in Primordia.
Qmoeva F is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a golden qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from Urdu's Qmoeva in Cauldros.
Qmoeva G is a Holofigure in . It depicts a blue qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from Sadar's Qmoeva in Sylvalum.
Qmoeva H is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a green qmoeva variant. It can be obtained from Gadaf's Qmoeva at the Primordia Waters.

Pugio Series is a Holofigure in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It depicts a Meredith & Co. Knife. It is obtained as a reward for completing the Normal Mission The Line of Fire. The Pugio weapons available in-game are: * Archetype Pugio * Iron Pugio * Carbide Pugio * Cermet Pugio * Chrome Pugio * Chromoly Pugio * Cobalt Pugio * Titanium Pugio * Ceramic Pugio * Diamond Pugio

Puge Patrol is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.4, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eight Shrads. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Queen (Japanese: クイーン, Kuīn) may refer to: * The Arachno Queen family in , a much larger kind of Arachnos with two abdomens instead of one, comprising: ** The Arachno Queen boss and its nest location ** The Deified Queen quest exclusive enemy ** The Queen Arachno enemies in and * Queen Raqura, the Regnant of the Kingdom of Uraya in * The Masked Queens of Keves and Agnus in

Raging Lava Giants is a Squad Mission in . It is part of BLADE Mission No.20, and is unlocked when the Squad has completed the Squad Task of hunting eighteen Aeviters. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.

Pure Luck is a Support Mission in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is unlocked when Chapter 12 is completed. It allows the player to quickly raise affinity with party members, and earn Division Points to raise one's BLADE Level. Enemies do not drop any items in this mission. It can be accepted at the Network Console in the BLADE Barracks.
Pull is a debuff in Xenoblade Chronicles X. Pull causes those afflicted to be flung towards the source of the attack. It could be considered the opposite of Launch.
The Prototype Bodywear is Medium Wear torso armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.
Prototype Trekware are Casual Wear upper-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Prototype BLADE Pants are Casual Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Pulverizing Glaives are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 90,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Glaives II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Longswords. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 135,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Lances are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Javelins. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 117,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Edges are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 81,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Edges II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Dual Swords in the Edges II Series. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 81,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Lightblades are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 126,000 Credits.
Pulverizing Lightblades II are melee weapons in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are Photon Sabers. They can be obtained from the Shop Terminal in Armory Alley for 126,000 Credits.
Prototype Trekpants are Casual Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Prototype Workpants are Casual Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Prototype BLADE Wear are Casual Wear upper-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Prototype Workwear are Casual Wear upper-body armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
Prototype Scouters are Casual Wear head armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries.
The Prototype Sleeve L is BLADE Wear left arm armor in and . It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.
The Prototype Sleeve R is BLADE Wear right arm armor in and . It is part of Cross's initial equipment and is not obtainable by any other means.
The Prototype Pants are BLADE Wear leg armor in and . They are part of Cross's initial equipment and are not obtainable by any other means.
Quality Cores are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be obtained from M104 Fortress Units, the Reinforcement M104 in Sword Valley, or traded from Bozatrox.
Quality Cranks are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be traded for with Mixik and Qofaria, and dropped by various small Mechon.
Quality Fuses are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be traded for with Zilex and Eleqa.
Quality Pelts are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by various high-level Bunnivs, Feris, and Hox, and are not available through trading.
Quality Scales are common materials in . They can be dropped by Throne Sardis, Envy Sardis, and Sol Gradys.
Quality Shafts are rare materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They cannot be traded for, but are dropped by Mechon in Sword Valley and Galahad Fortress.
Quality Skins are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by high-level Lizards and Brogs.
Quirky Livers are common materials in Xenoblade Chronicles. They can be dropped by Makna Piranhax and Whapol Sardis or traded for with Tuzu.
Prototype Boots are Light Wear leg armor in Xenoblade Chronicles X. They are manufactured by Sakuraba Industries and are a part of the ZZZ armor range.

Pupunin is an NPC in . He is a Nopon salvager who can primarily be found at the Central Exchange in Goldmouth. He works for Chairman Bana at the Argentum Trade Guild. Pupunin gives no quests or Merc Missions.
Quotelettas are Meat Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Bassani Butchers in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain. They are one of the favorite Pouch items of Mòrag.

Quake Rhinons (Japanese: , Kuweiku Raino) are enemies in . They are members of the Rhinon family, and can be found at level 33-35 in the Chansagh Wastes of the Empire of Mor Ardain. Raider Igna and Venal Igna are riding on them.
Puffoundations are Cosmetic Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Cosmetipolitan in Torigoth in the Gormott Province. Two are obtained as a reward for completing the quest Knocked About Nopon.

Quattor Street (Japanese: , Katorusu-dōri) is a Location in . It is located at Goetuis Port in the Indoline Praetorium. Elnatauro Inn, Regulus Blacksmiths, Demois Aux Cores, Aquarius Salvaging, and Koacurio Accessories can be found here.
Puresnow Passage (Japanese: , Shirayuki no Kairō) is a Landmark in . It is located in Theoscaldia Palace in the Kingdom of Tantal.
Puri Leaf Salads are Veggie Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Llysiau Greens in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Puzzletree Pouches are Textile Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Neuromin Textiles in Torigoth in the Gormott Province.
Punk Dolls are Art Pouch items in . They can be purchased from Yafush Antiques in Alba Cavanich in the Empire of Mor Ardain.

Queen Arachnos (Japanese: , Kuīn Supaido) are enemies in . They are members of the Arachno family and can be found at level 73-75 on the underground path between Coolley Lake and Varnax's Plunge in the Gormott Province.
|-|XC2 = |-|TTGC = Puzzletree Woods are Tree collectibles in and . They can be found in Gormott Province and Gormott.
Radliev Pods (Japanese: , Radoriafu Poddo) are enemies in . They are Pods, and can be found at level 39 - 44 on Lumos Pillar on the Upper Level of the Kingdom of Tantal.

Radyo Marrins (Japanese: , Radio Mārin) are enemies in . They are members of the Marrin family, and can be found at level 46-48 at the Canyon of Husks on the Upper Level of the Spirit Crucible Elpys, or at the Stele of Judgment in the Lower Level area. Two must be defeated in order to unlock T-elos's level 4 "Heaven's Tracker" on her affinity chart.
Puffots (Japanese: , Shigaru) are a family of aerial enemies in and . They are avian creatures similar in appearance to macaws, and similar in size to Peng. They come in blue and red varieties.

|-|Common = |-|Rare = |-|Legendary = Quantum Scarves (Japanese: , Kuantamu Mafurā) are accessories in . They extend the duration of the Break reaction by up to 49% (4.9 seconds).
